articles.title: PREVIEW: Panthers ready to face ‘great transition game’ in Anaheim
‘A great boost’: Marchand set to make season debut vs. Ducks
Gudas welcomed back with ovation during return to Anaheim
Barkov placed on long-term injured reserve by Panthers, timeline unknown

out.detail: lower-body injury, on long-term injured reserve (LTIR)
lower-body injury (missed final 19 games last season, returned for this game)

away.summary: The Florida Panthers are missing their captain, Aleksander Barkov, who is on long-term injured reserve. They are relying on depth and returning players like Brad Marchand and Gustav Forsling. The team has a strong record against the Ducks and is looking to continue their strong start to the season.

home.summary: The Los Angeles Kings are looking to build on their first point of the season after a close overtime loss to the Sharks. They have a strong offensive line with players like Adrian Kempe and Quinton Byfield, but they are missing key players like Drew Helleson and Ian Moore.
